51479612.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to His6-tagged ENL YEATS domain (unknown origin) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 DE3 assessed as dissociation constant by surface plasmon resonance analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface Plasmon: SPR binding analysis methodology can be used to study molecular interactions. Herein, SPR was applied to measure the interactions between compound 1 and the ENL protein. Initially, protein was prepared in 10 mM sodium acetate (pH 5.5) and then immobilized covalently by an amine-coupling reaction on a CMS sensor chip. The remaining binding sites of the sensor chip were then blocked by ethanolamine. Addition of compound 1, the flow-through analyte, to the chamber resulted in binding to the immobilized protein ligand, producing a small change in refractive index at the gold surface. In this step, compound was diluted in HBS-EP buffer (20 mM HEPES at pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% v/v P20) to the desired concentration and was injected over the chip at a flow rate of 10 μL/min. All the above buffers, solutions, and sensor chips were placed at room temperature before the run. The association time and dissociation time were both set at 120 s. Binding affinities were obtained from the ratio of rate constants to directly characterize protein–molecular interactions. Data analysis was completed via the state model of T200 evaluation software (GE Healthcare).
original_paragraph.Figure 7C caption: Figure 7. Compound 1 inhibits ENL protein binding to H3K27ac in vitro and can also directly bind to the ENL protein. (A) The inhibitory ratios of compounds 1 to 5 were determined at 100, 50, and 25 μM by the AlphaScreen assay. (B) The IC50 value of 1 was determined to be 7.3 μM by the AlphaScreen assay. (C) The KD value of 1 was determined to be 5.0 μM using SPR.
original_paragraph.Figure 7C sensorgram data: The sensorgram in Figure 7C shows response units (Ru) over time (s). The x-axis ranges from 0 to 300 s. The y-axis ranges from -20 to 100 Ru. The curves are labeled with concentrations: 66.7 μM, 44.4 μM, 29.6 μM, 19.8 μM, 13.2 μM, 8.8 μM, and 5.9 μM. The plot indicates an association phase (0-120 s) and a dissociation phase (120-300 s). The text on the plot explicitly states 'KD = 5.0 μM'.
original_paragraph.Results section - SPR assay: To validate whether compound 1 could bind to the ENL protein in vitro, a surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay, which is a surface-sensitive optical method to monitor biological interactions (Figure S17-2, Supporting Information), was conducted to determine the binding affinity between 1 and ENL. The equilibrium dissociation constant (KD) value of 5.0 μM for 1 binding to ENL (Figure 7C) was consistent with the inhibitory activity obtained from the AlphaScreen assay. All these results collectively suggested that 1 can bind directly to the ENL protein and inhibit its interaction with H3K27ac in vitro.
